words.title: Smithfield Returns
words.body:
TwinkleTown will return to *Smithfield Square* this Christmas, bringing back its mix of festive attractions and entertainment.

Visitors can expect ice skating, a Big Wheel, vintage funfair, live music, festive food and an Irish makers’ market.
words.details:
**ICE RINK · BIG WHEEL · FUNFAIR**
